mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO bid_notice ( crawl_source_id, external_id, notice_ord, notice_type, notice_name, external_notice_status, international_bid_type, notice_agency, demand_agency, announced_at, bid_start_at, bid_deadline_at, opening_at, base_amount, estimated_amount, bid_method, contract_method, participation_qualification_text, joint_contract_allowed, joint_contract_text, source_url, has_attachment, notice_status, crawled_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{notice.externalId}, #{notice.noticeOrder}, #{notice.noticeType}, #{notice.noticeName}, #{notice.externalNoticeStatus}, #{notice.internationalBidType}, #{notice.noticeAgency}, #{notice.demandAgency}, #{notice.announcedAt}, #{notice.bidStartAt}, #{notice.bidDeadlineAt}, #{notice.openingAt}, #{notice.baseAmount}, #{notice.estimatedAmount}, #{notice.bidMethod}, #{notice.contractMethod}, #{notice.participationQualificationText}, #{notice.jointContractAllowed}, #{notice.jointContractText}, #{notice.sourceUrl}, #{hasAttachments}, 'COLLECTED', #{crawledAt}, #{crawledAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE bid_notice SET notice_type = #{notice.noticeType}, notice_name = #{notice.noticeName}, external_notice_status = #{notice.externalNoticeStatus}, international_bid_type = #{notice.internationalBidType}, notice_agency = #{notice.noticeAgency}, demand_agency = #{notice.demandAgency}, announced_at = #{notice.announcedAt}, bid_start_at = #{notice.bidStartAt}, bid_deadline_at = #{notice.bidDeadlineAt}, opening_at = #{notice.openingAt}, base_amount = #{notice.baseAmount}, estimated_amount = #{notice.estimatedAmount}, bid_method = #{notice.bidMethod}, contract_method = #{notice.contractMethod}, participation_qualification_text = #{notice.participationQualificationText}, joint_contract_allowed = #{notice.jointContractAllowed}, joint_contract_text = #{notice.jointContractText}, source_url = #{notice.sourceUrl}, has_attachment = CASE WHEN #{hasAttachments} THEN TRUE ELSE has_attachment END, crawled_at = #{crawledAt}, updated_at = #{crawledAt}, deleted_at = NULL WHERE bid_notice_id = #{noticeId}
